title: Menu
deleteHelp: Menus with child menus or assigned to roles cannot be deleted.
menuTypeHelp: A directory holds child menus; a menu opens a page; a button only controls permissions and is not shown in the menu.
iconHelp: Only Iconify names are supported, in the form "collection:icon", e.g. lucide:user. Pick one on the right, or type a name from another collection.
iconInvalid: Invalid icon name. Use an Iconify name, e.g. lucide:user
pathHelp: One segment of the URL, e.g. user. For external or embedded pages, enter a full address starting with http(s)://.
componentHelp: Page path under the frontend views directory, without .vue, e.g. system/post/index. Pages not yet built show "Coming soon".
permsHelp: Same as {'@'}SaCheckPermission on the backend API, in the form "module:business:action".
queryParamHelp: Parameters passed when the page opens, as a JSON object.
queryParamInvalid: Invalid route query. Use a JSON object, e.g. {'{'}"type": "1"{'}'}
activeMenuHelp: Menu path to highlight while this hidden page is open.
isFrameHelp: Yes: open the route path in a new window. No with an http(s) route path: embed the page.
isCacheHelp: Keep the page state when switching tabs and coming back.
visibleHelp: Hidden menus are not shown in the menu but can still be opened by URL.
statusHelp: Disabled menus are hidden and their permissions no longer apply.
